notes.title: Update for Russian language support!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/23d0d57383853ea20b3b926f6e796406691bb7d3.png[/img]

We received an offer from VNka to fan-translate D10RAMA's work on this title, "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure"!
This was an unexpected pleasure for us, and we decided to take this opportunity to make this update so that users in Russian-speaking countries can enjoy "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" as well.
We are deeply grateful to VNka and Quest Lion for their steady translation work.
The Russian title is named "Пропавшие под дождём" as they suggested!

You can switch languages from the title screen.
We hope that many more people will enjoy this update!

---

Мы получили предложение на фанатский перевод работы D10RAMA "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" от VNka!
Это было для нас неожиданной радостью, и мы решили использовать эту возможность для создания этого полноценного обновления, чтобы "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" смогли насладиться читатели из русскоязычных стран.
Мы очень благодарны VNka и QuestLion за их усердную работу над переводом.
Русское название - "Пропавшие под дождём", как они и предложили!

Вы можете поменять язык в главном меню.
Мы надеемся, что это обновление обрадует большое количество людей!

notes.title: "Absent in the Rain" is now Spanish!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/c6e610aae2d0508fe1e49edd7eec68cb2fcb46de.png[/img]
[h2]Spanish update of "Absent in the Rain" is now available![/h2]

While we were working on the English update of "Ame ni shite hito hitori", Shinzou translations offered us the opportunity to fan-translate D10RAMA's work.
This was an unexpected pleasure for us, and we decided to take this opportunity to make this update so that Spanish-speaking users can enjoy "Absent in the Rain" as well.
We would like to thank Shinzou translations for their prompt translation work.
The title of this update is "Perdidos en la Lluvia" as suggested by Shinzou translations.

You can switch languages from the title screen.
We hope that more people will enjoy this update!

---

¡Hemos actualizado "Absent in the Rain" para agregar una versión en español!

Mientras trabajábamos en la traducción al inglés de "Absent in the rain", Shinzou translations nos ofreció hacer una traducción de nuestro juego.
Fue una inesperada sorpresa y decidimos aprovechar la oportunidad para que los usuarios hispanohablantes pudieran disfrutar de "Absent in the Rain".
Queremos dar las gracias a Shinzou translations por su rapidez a la hora de realizar la traducción.
El título que escogimos surgió de la sugerencia de Shinzou translations: "Perdidos en la Lluvia".

Pueden cambiar el idioma desde el menú principal.
¡Esperamos que con esta actualización más personas disfruten de nuestra historia!

notes.title: “Absent in the Rain” is now Simplified Chinese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/faaa229224f4bd21015c11398197bcd52b1d7e6e.png[/img]

Thank you for your patience!

As announced, we have made an update to the game “Absent in the Rain”, which can now be played in Simplified Chinese. The title of the Chinese version is “雨霏霏，人非人”. Special thanks to 346lab Localization for the translation! You can switch the language from the title screen.

Please enjoy the Chinese version of "Absent in the Rain"!

---

各位久等了！

《雨にして人を外れ》现已透过更新，支持简体中文语言。中文游戏标题为：《雨霏霏，人非人》。非常感谢 346lab Localization 提供的翻译！您可以在标题画面处切换游戏语言。

期望您在《雨霏霏，人非人》中，收获一段值得回味的游戏体验！

notes.title: “Ame ni shite hito wo hazure” will be available to play in English soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/9ec03ff51186b6329fcbf29c1d43453369975046.png[/img]

We have decided to update “雨にして人を外れ” so it can support the switch to the English version!

This VN was originally made for Japanese players.However, after the announcement of the game, we received comments from English-speaking users and requests to make an English version too. This was an unexpected delight for us, and we strongly felt that we would like for English-speaking players to be able to enjoy this work somehow. In the midst of this, translator Marta Güell contacted with us with a proposal to localize the game, and so we decided to publish an English version.We are very grateful to Marta for translating this game, which has a lot of difficult Japanese, without spoiling its atmosphere.After many discussions, the English title we decided on is “Absent in the Rain”, and we love it!

We hope that more people will enjoy this update!
Please wait for a while until the release!

---

「雨にして人を外れ」が、英語版への切り替えに対応したアップデートを行うことを決定いたしました！

本作「雨にして人を外れ」は最初、日本のユーザーに向け制作しました。しかし本作発表以降、英語圏のユーザーからのコメントをいただき、英語版を作って欲しいとの要望も多くいただきました。これは私たちにとって予想外の喜びであり、どうにかこの作品を英語圏のユーザーにも楽しんでもらいたいと強く考えるようになりました。そんな中、Marta Güell様から自分が英訳を担当するので英語版を出さないかという提案をいただき、今回の英語版への対応が決定しました。難しい日本語も多くある本作で作品の雰囲気を損なうことなく英訳いただいたMarta様には本当に感謝しております。タイトルは何度も議論を重ね”Absent in the Rain”に決定しました。私たちはこのタイトルをとても気に入っています。

このアップデートによってより多くの方に楽しんでもらえると幸いです！
リリースまでもうしばらくお待ち下さい！

notes.title: "Ame ni shite hito wo hazure" coming soon in Chinese!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/6f434390e13f12eeac523d0b09016fdc8f4d6b83.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that we will be adding Simplified Chinese to the title "Ame ni shite hito wo hazure" so that it can be played by Chinese speakers!
The translation will be done by 346lab Localization. We thank 346lab Localization for their high-quality translation work. 
We hope that with the release of the Chinese version, many more people will be able to enjoy the game. 

Please wait a little longer for the release!

---

为了让各位中文玩家能以熟悉的语言游玩本作，我们决定推出《雨にして人を外れ》的更新，增加简体中文语言的支持！
简中翻译由346lab Localization负责。非常感谢他们提供的高质量翻译。
我们希望这次中文化能让更多的玩家享受到作品带来的乐趣。

敬请大家耐心等候更新推出，谢谢！
